name: Blake: A Reproducible, Rights-Bounded William Blake Corpus Workflow

isBasedOn.name: Mapping William Blake’s Works (earlier working-paper PDF)

description: Blake builds a reproducible local corpus workflow for William Blake texts, images, metadata, analysis results, visual summaries, exports, and reports, with an auditable target ledger and a fail-closed rights gate separating open-source code and aggregate analytics from provider-supplied source files.
